info.name: FixMyWindow API
info.description:
FixMyWindow (FMW) — REST API Collection

**Base URL:** {{base_url}} (set by active environment)

**Environments:**
- FixMyWindow — Dev → https://dev.fixmywindow.co/api/v1
- FixMyWindow — Production → https://fixmywindow.co/api/v1

All requests require:
- Content-Type: application/json
- Accept: application/json

Authenticated requests require:
- Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}

request.description: Submit a contact us enquiry. Public endpoint — no authentication required.

item.name: Uploads
item.description: Serves files stored on the cloud disk (public/uploads). Every request under /api is routed into this app; there is no static-file passthrough at the webserver level, so uploaded files (blueprint photos, survey photos, snag photos, handover PDFs, etc.) are streamed back through this route rather than served directly by Apache.

request.description: Fetches a stored file by its path. Replace the path segments with the actual file_path/url returned by the relevant resource (e.g. a blueprint photo's url field). No authentication required — matches prior public static-file behaviour.

item.name: Customer Auth
item.description: OTP-based B2C auth and B2B email/password auth.

request.description:
Send OTP to a registered B2C customer phone number.

**Dummy OTP (non-production):** `123456`
Register a new B2C customer. After registration, call `send-otp` then `verify-otp` to receive tokens.

Login an existing B2C customer using OTP. Auto-saves `access_token` and `refresh_token`.

**Dummy OTP (non-production):** `123456`
Exchange refresh token for a new access token.
Logout customer. Revokes the refresh token and invalidates the JWT.
Register a new B2B customer with email + password. A verification email is sent. Call B2B Login after verifying email.
Login as a B2B customer using email + password. Auto-saves `access_token` and `refresh_token`.

variable.description: 64-character hex token from the verification email link

request.description: Verify a B2B customer's email address using the token from the verification email.
Resend the email verification link to a B2B customer.
Update the authenticated customer's profile. All fields are optional.
Returns all distinct service-location addresses previously used by the authenticated customer.

item.name: Customer Enquiries
item.description: Customer-facing booking (enquiry) endpoints. Requires: Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}

request.description: Creates a booking for both B2C and B2B customers in a single step. Saves `enquiry_id` to collection variable on success.
List all bookings placed by the authenticated customer.
Fetch a single booking by ID.

item.name: Customer Blueprints
item.description: Blueprint CRUD for authenticated customers. Requires: Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}

request.description: Returns all blueprints belonging to the authenticated customer.
Creates a new blueprint. `towers` JSON is auto-generated server-side. Saves `blueprint_id` to collection variable.
Fetch a single blueprint by ID.
Update a blueprint.
Delete a blueprint by ID.
Upload one or more photos for an enquiry's blueprint (multipart/form-data). Accepts JPG/PNG, max 10MB each. Saves first photo ID to blueprint_photo_id.
List all blueprint photos for a given enquiry/booking.
Delete a specific blueprint photo by enquiry/booking ID. Also removes the file from storage.
Fetch the blueprint linked to an enquiry. NOTE: testing only - this reuses the Admin handler and is NOT scoped to the authenticated customer, so any id is accessible.

Link an existing blueprint to an enquiry. Returns 409 if one is already linked. NOTE: testing only - this reuses the Admin handler and is NOT scoped to the authenticated customer, so any id is accessible.

item.name: Customer Project Stages
item.description: Project stage records exposed to the customer guard for testing. These routes reuse the Admin\ProjectStageController as-is and are NOT scoped to the authenticated customer - any project stage id is readable, writable and deletable by any logged-in customer.

request.description: Fetch a single project stage record by ID. NOTE: testing only - this reuses the Admin handler and is NOT scoped to the authenticated customer, so any id is accessible.
Update the shared towers JSON data for a project stage record. NOTE: testing only - this reuses the Admin handler and is NOT scoped to the authenticated customer, so any id is accessible.
Delete a project stage record. NOTE: testing only - this reuses the Admin handler and is NOT scoped to the authenticated customer, so any id is accessible.
Self-signup for new team members. Creates account with `is_active = false`. Must be approved before login.

Login as admin staff. Auto-saves `admin_access_token` and `admin_refresh_token`.

**Seeded credentials:**
- Email: admin@fixmywindow.in
- Password: Admin@1234
Exchange admin refresh token for a new access token.
Logout admin. Revokes the refresh token and invalidates the JWT.
Change password for the currently logged-in admin.

variable.description: 64-character hex token from the verification email link

request.description: Verify an admin user's email address using the token from the verification email.
Resend the verification email to the currently logged-in admin user.

item.name: Admin Users
item.description: Staff/user management. Requires ops_admin role. Authorization: Bearer {{admin_access_token}}

request.description: Create a new admin staff account directly (created with `is_active = true`).
Approve a pending self-signup user. Sets `is_active = true`.
Reject a pending self-signup user. Sends rejection email then deletes the record.
Returns all active ops_admin, supervisor, and technician users with name, phone, and role.

query.description: Optional. One of: ops_manager, supervisor, technician. Only ops_admin may use this filter. If omitted, ops_admin gets all staff across the three roles combined; any other role always gets only their own record regardless of this param.

request.description: ops_admin: returns paginated staff (optionally filtered to one role) with project stats and active enquiry numbers; omitting role returns all staff. ops_manager/supervisor/technician: always returns only their own record/stats, regardless of the role param.
List all admin users pending approval (is_active = false).

item.name: Admin Customers
item.description: Customer master data with their booking history. Accessible by all internal roles (ops_admin, ops_manager, supervisor, technician). Authorization: Bearer {{admin_access_token}}

request.description: Returns a paginated list of all customers along with their booking (enquiry) details — booking id, service, status, payment status, and progress.

item.name: Admin Enquiries
item.description: All enquiry and project-execution operations in one place. Requires: Authorization: Bearer {{admin_access_token}}

request.description: Returns all active project statuses ordered by sort_order.
List all customer bookings across the platform (admin view).
Fetch a single booking's full detail by ID (admin view).
Update the overall status of an enquiry. Allowed values: assigned, in_progress, completed, cancelled. Writes a timeline entry in the same transaction.
Full-replace all section assignments for an enquiry. Allowed sections: ops_manager, supervisor, survey, measurement, quality_check, installation.
List all staff currently assigned to a project.
Add an internal note to an enquiry.
List all notes recorded against an enquiry.
Links a blueprint to an enquiry. Returns 409 if the enquiry already has a blueprint linked.

Permanently deletes an enquiry and cascades to its assignments, timeline, survey, project stage, notes and blueprint photos (files removed from storage too). The linked blueprint itself is not deleted, only unlinked. ops_admin/ops_manager only.

item.name: Admin Surveys
item.description: Survey management: create, checklist, and Go/No-Go decision. Requires ops_admin or ops_manager role.

request.description: Create a new survey linked to an enquiry. Sets the enquiry status to `survey_initiated` and writes `Inspection Scheduled` to the timeline, in the same transaction. Saves `survey_id` on success.
Paginated list of surveys. Filter by `enquiry_id` to find the survey for a specific enquiry. Auto-saves `survey_id` from first result.
Get full survey details including all sections and current outcome.

Save all three survey sections in one shot.

**result** values: `yes`, `no`, `n_a`, `n_r`

**severity** values: `high`, `medium`, `low`
Submit the final Go/No-Go decision. `go` creates a project; `no_go` rejects; `hold` saves without deciding.

item.name: Admin Blueprints
item.description: Admin blueprint operations. Requires: Authorization: Bearer {{admin_access_token}}

request.description: Fetch the blueprint for a given enquiry (admin view).
Create a blueprint for a customer (admin).
Update the blueprint (admin override).

item.name: Get All Blueprints by Customer ID

request.description: Fetch all blueprints created by a specific customer (admin view).
Delete the blueprint by ID (admin).
Upload one or more photos for an enquiry's blueprint (admin). Multipart/form-data. Accepts JPG/PNG, max 10MB each.
List all blueprint photos for a given enquiry/booking (admin view).
Delete a specific blueprint photo by enquiry/booking ID (admin). Also removes the file from storage.

Create a project stage record linked to an enquiry. The same `towers` JSON shape is shared and updated across measurement, quality_check, and installation — there is no `type` distinguishing them. Saves `project_stage_id` on success.
Retrieve a project stage record by ID.
Update the shared towers JSON data for a project stage record.
Delete a project stage record by ID.

query.description: Max recent_activity items to return (default 10, max 50).
Max urgent_requests items to return (default 4, max 20).

request.description: Admin dashboard: hero totals (today/week/rolling week/month), status donut (pending/in_progress/completed/cancelled), revenue cards with trend %, last-7-day revenue bar chart, recent activity feed (project_timeline-backed), team overview headcounts, and SLA-derived urgent requests list.
